To

All RPFCs (In-charge of Regional Office)

Sub:-Review of long pending 7A / 14B cases and confirmation of number
of cases pending with all Regional Offices under Section 7A / 14B
~ reg.

Ref:- (i) Head Office circular letter No. C-1/3(28)2016/7A and 14B/
27519 dated 05.03.2018.

Sir,
In continuation of Head Office circular letter dated 05.03.2018 on the

above mentioned subject whereby it was requested to monitor the performance
for disposal of 7A / 146 cases of ROs those are under your jurisdiction on regular
basis.

2. Further, regarding hearing and disposal off 7A / 14B cases through e-
proceeding portal only, it is noticed that there are 68,585 cases pending as on
31.12.2018 in e-proceeding portal whereas as per compliance MIS Dashboard
there are 67,817 cases are pending as on 31.12.2018. .

3. Therefore, all RPFCs are requested to immediately review the pendency of
7A / 14B cases as per prescribed procedure between e-proceeding as well as
Compliance MIS Das!iboard and ensure that necessary action is taken by the
field office under their jurisdiction to ensure that the data in both matches
perfectly without any p in between.

This is s with the approval of ACC(HQ)(Compliance)

Yours faithfully,
